values.quote: apply a ''Soul-Mark'' to the target hit for 4 seconds
''Soul-Mark'' cannot affect an enemy more than once every few seconds.

mechanics.claim: Soul-Mark's bonus damage requires both Kalista's and the Oathsworn's marks on the same target, then consumes both marks; only applies while tethered.
mechanics.quote: While '''Kalista''' and her ''{{ii|The Black Spear|Oathsworn}}'' are {{tip|tether|tethered}}, their basic attacks and ''{{ai|Pierce|Kalista}}'' apply a ''Soul-Mark''

mechanics.claim: The damage is dealt on-attack if Kalista applies the second mark, or on-hit if the Oathsworn does so instead.
mechanics.quote: The damage is dealt {{tip|on-attack}} of '''Kalista's''' basic attack if she applies the second mark. If the ''Oathsworn'' does so instead, the damage is dealt [[on-hit]] of their basic attack.

mechanics.claim: Soul-Marked's bonus damage is credited to Kalista and benefits from her magic penetration and spell effects.
mechanics.quote: ''Soul-Marked's'' bonus damage is credited to '''Kalista''' and will benefit from both her {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|magic penetration}}}} and [[spell effects]].

mechanics.claim: Non-champion targets take capped damage instead of the percent max health damage.
mechanics.quote: the marks are consumed to deal {{as|magic damage}} to the target, capped against non-champions
